g9-history-uh1-t1.overview: Meaning of Prehistory and History sits inside The Discipline of History and Human Evolution. The discipline of history opens Unit 1 of Grade 9 History in the Ethiopian (FDRE Ministry of Education) curriculum. First, it defines prehistory and history and shows how historians work with sources and dates. Then it turns to human evolution and the place of Ethiopia and Africa in the human story. Next, it follows the Stone Age from the first tools to early farming. Finally, it explains how the earliest states emerged. Students will also learn how the discipline of history applies to real-life situations, such as reading evidence and telling fact from opinion.
objectives: Discuss the main objectives of studying the discipline of history.
Distinguish prehistory from history, as well as fact from opinion.
Compare primary and secondary sources and evaluate their reliability.
Evaluate the place of Ethiopia and Africa in human evolution.
Describe the stages of the Stone Age and the Neolithic Revolution.
g9-history-uh1-t1.simple:
Meaning of Prehistory and History in plain words. The exam wants you to recognise the core ideas, not to memorise whole paragraphs. Focus on:
  • First, history as the study of the human past based on evidence.
  • Then the line between prehistory, before writing, and history, after writing began.
  • Also the difference between a historical fact and an opinion.
g9-history-uh1-t1.detailed:
Meaning of Prehistory and History — the essentials. First, history as the study of the human past based on evidence. Then the line between prehistory, before writing, and history, after writing began. Also the difference between a historical fact and an opinion.
